sections.name: Pricing tiers
sections.description: The tier grid: centered header, plan cards with per-tier AI query allowances, a highlighted most-popular plan carrying the one orange CTA, an enterprise strip and a launch-offer footnote. The core of any pricing page; the single-plan variant doubles as an in-page pricing band for landing pages.

sections.name: Enterprise band
sections.description: Full-width tailored-enterprise panel to sit under the tier grid: one soft periwinkle glow, security and compliance chips (SSO, roles, audit, residency), dedicated-support and rollout proof rows, and a talk-to-sales CTA. Use when enterprise is a note under the tiers rather than its own plan column.
